'''Walix Ve'ra''' was a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who served under the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]]. He was present in the [[Strike Base XR-484|Imperial Command Center]] on [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] during the Empire's [[Invasion of Ossus|invasion]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="Knights of the Eternal Throne" />

==Behind the scenes==
Walix Ve'ra serves as a crew-skill trainer for artifice on the Imperial Side at [[Ossus/Legends|Ossus]] within the game ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="Knights of the Eternal Throne" />

*''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Knights of the Eternal Throne]]'' {{1st}}
